Population.evidence_source: As their situations continued to cause increasing concern, participants described efforts to seek help on behalf of their relatives. In an acute situation, such as the aftermath of an actual suicide attempt, health services were sought. However, participants were disappointed that even with their perceptions of the seriousness of the situation, and despite making full and complete disclosures, they felt their concerns were not taken seriously.

Type.evidence_source: I could see him getting worse and worse, but every time he went to hospital after he'd tried to stab himself or do something stupid, they let him out again because when he was in there, he looked like there was nothing wrong with him. He was the sort of person who could make himself look like there was nothing wrong with him and pretend and, to me, that was ridiculous. That this is a psychiatrist who supposedly knows—I even wrote in point form, all the weird things that he'd done when he was at home and all the things that he'd said and presented it to them and they still ignored it. (Kirsten).
